entries.title: Numbers 22:1
segments: And the sons of Israel pulled up and pitched in the plains of Moab on this side Jordan [by] Jericho.

entries.title: Numbers 22:2
segments: And Balak the son of Zippor saw all that Israel had done to the Amorites.

entries.title: Numbers 22:3
segments: And Moab was much afraid of the people because they [were] many. And Moab was worried because of the sons of Israel.

entries.title: Numbers 22:4
segments: And Moab said to the elders of Midian, Now this company is licking up all around us, as the ox licks up the grass of the field. And Balak the son of Zippor [was] king of the Moabites at that time.

entries.title: Numbers 22:5
segments: He sent messengers therefore to Balaam the son of Beor, to Pethor, by the river of the land of the sons of his people, to call him, saying, Behold! A people come out from Egypt. Behold! They cover the face of the earth, and they are staying across from me.

entries.title: Numbers 22:6
segments: Therefore, I pray you, come now and curse this people for me. For they [are] too mighty for me. Perhaps I shall prevail so that we may strike them, and so that I may drive them out of the land. For I know that he whom you bless is blessed, and he whom you curse is cursed.

entries.title: Numbers 22:7
segments: And the elders of Moab and the elders of Midian pulled up with the rewards of divination in their hand. And they came to Balaam and spoke the words of Balak to him.

entries.title: Numbers 22:8
segments: And he said to them, stay here tonight, and I will bring you word again, as the LORD shall speak to me. And the leaders of Moab stayed with Balaam.

entries.title: Numbers 22:9
segments: And God came to Balaam and said, What men [are] these with you?

entries.title: Numbers 22:10
segments: And Balaam said to God, Balak the son of Zippor, king of Moab, has sent to me, [saying],

entries.title: Numbers 22:11
segments: Behold! A people has come out of Egypt which covers the face of the earth. Come now, curse them for me. Perhaps, I shall be able to overcome them and drive them out.

entries.title: Numbers 22:12
segments: And God said to Balaam, You shall not go with them. You shall not curse the people, for they [are] blessed.

entries.title: Numbers 22:13
segments: And Balaam rose up in the morning and said to the leaders of Balak, Go into your land, for the LORD refuses to let me go with you.

entries.title: Numbers 22:14
segments: And the leaders of Moab rose up. And they went to Balak and said, Balaam refuses to come with us.

entries.title: Numbers 22:15
segments: And Balak sent leaders again, more and more honorable than those.

entries.title: Numbers 22:16
segments: And they came to Balaam and said to him, So says Balak the son of Zippor, Please let nothing hinder you from coming to me.

entries.title: Numbers 22:17
segments: For I will raise you up to very great honor, and I will do whatever you say to me. Please come then and curse this people for me.

entries.title: Numbers 22:18
segments: And Balaam answered and said to the servants of Balak, If Balak would give me his house full of silver and gold, I cannot go beyond the word of the LORD my God, to do less or more.

entries.title: Numbers 22:19
segments: But please now stay here also this night so that I may know what more the LORD will say to me.

entries.title: Numbers 22:20
segments: And God came to Balaam at night and said to him, If the men come to call you, rise up, go with them. But still, the word which I shall say to you, that you shall do.

entries.title: Numbers 22:21
segments: And Balaam rose up in the morning and saddled his ass, and went with the rulers of Moab.

entries.title: Numbers 22:22
segments: And God's anger was kindled because he went. And the Angel of the LORD stood in the way as an enemy against him. And he was riding upon his ass, and his two servants with him.

entries.title: Numbers 22:23
segments: And the ass saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way, and His sword drawn in His hand. And the ass turned aside out of the way and went into the field. And Balaam struck the ass, to turn her into the way.

entries.title: Numbers 22:24
segments: But the Angel of the LORD stood in a path of the vineyards, a wall on this side, and a wall on that side.

entries.title: Numbers 22:25
segments: And when the ass saw the Angel of the LORD, she pushed herself into the wall and crushed Balaam's foot against the wall. And he struck her again.

entries.title: Numbers 22:26
segments: And the Angel of the LORD went further and stood in a narrow place, where [there was] no way to turn either to the right hand or to the left.

entries.title: Numbers 22:27
segments: And when the ass saw the Angel of the LORD, she fell down under Balaam. And Balaam's anger was kindled, and he struck the ass with a staff.

entries.title: Numbers 22:28
segments: And the LORD opened the mouth of the ass, and she said to Balaam, What have I done to you, that you have beaten me these three times?

entries.title: Numbers 22:29
segments: And Balaam said to the ass, Because you have mocked me. I wish there were a sword in my hand, for now I would kill you.

entries.title: Numbers 22:30
segments: And the ass said to Balaam, [Am] I not your ass, upon which you have ridden ever since [I was] yours, to this day? Was I ever known to do so to you? And he said, No.

entries.title: Numbers 22:31
segments: Then the LORD opened the eyes of Balaam, and he saw the Angel of the LORD standing in the way, and His sword drawn in His hand. And he bowed down his head, and fell on his face.

entries.title: Numbers 22:32
segments: And the Angel of the LORD said to him, Why have you beaten your ass these three times? Behold! I went out to be an enemy to you, because your [way] is perverse before Me.

entries.title: Numbers 22:33
segments: And the ass saw Me and turned from Me these three times. Unless she had turned from Me, surely now I also would have killed you and saved her alive.

entries.title: Numbers 22:34
segments: And Balaam said to the Angel of the LORD, I have sinned. For I did not know that You stood in the way against me. Now therefore, if it displeases You, I will go back again.

entries.title: Numbers 22:35
segments: And the Angel of the LORD said to Balaam, Go with the men. But only the word that I shall speak to you, that you shall speak. So Balaam went with the leaders of Balak.

entries.title: Numbers 22:36
segments: And when Balak heard that Balaam had come, he went out to meet him, to a city of Moab, in the border of Arnon, which [is] in the outermost border.

entries.title: Numbers 22:37
segments: And Balak said to Balaam, Did I not earnestly send to you to call you? Why did you not come to me? Am I not able indeed to lift you up to honor?

entries.title: Numbers 22:38
segments: And Balaam said to Balak, Lo, I have come to you. Have I now any power at all to say anything? The word that God puts in my mouth, that I shall speak.

entries.title: Numbers 22:39
segments: And Balaam went with Balak, and they came to Kirjath-huzoth.

entries.title: Numbers 22:40
segments: And Balak offered oxen and sheep, and sent to Balaam and to the leaders [that were] with him.

entries.title: Numbers 22:41
segments: And it happened on the next day Balak took Balaam and brought him up into the high places of Baal, so that from there he might see the edge of the people.
